basic_info.description: Beautifully renovated 4 bed/2 bath - Top Floor - Pacific Heights/Cow Hollow border condo exemplifying modern living in a historic context. Walking distance to Union St & Chestnut St corridors and steps from SF's most iconic amenities such as Fort Mason, Marina Green, Aquatic Park, and Lafayette Park. Classic Edwardian elegance welcomes you home with direct street access. Once inside, the natural light-filled expansive open floor plan seamlessly accommodates smart furniture placement. Excellent kitchen design with garden window, eat-in bar, and wine refrigerator. Optimal and flexible bedroom proximity with optional home office. Extensive renovation and refurbishment includes layout modification, wide plank Oak hardwood flooring, and luxurious spa-like bathroom. Additional storage. In unit laundry. Convenient parking options available.
